Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
WHEN 24 hours have passed since the purchase, the loyalty service shall post the pending points to the member's balance.
Rationale: Return window before points become usable.

Text: WHERE a bonus campaign is active for the store, the loyalty service shall apply the campaign multiplier to earned points.
WHEN a member requests the balance, the loyalty service shall return the posted points and the pending points separately.
Rationale: Members ask why new points are not usable yet (S-03).

Text: IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 300 posted points, THEN the loyalty service shall reject the redemption with the reason "below minimum".
Rationale: Minimum lowered for the year-end campaign (CR-001).

Text: WHEN 18 months have passed since points were posted, the loyalty service shall expire those points.
Rationale: Programme terms; Finance (SH-03) needs a bounded points liability.

Text: IF a support agent submits an adjustment above 5,000 points, THEN the admin console shall require approval by a second support agent before posting the adjustment.
IF a support agent submits an adjustment above 5,000 points, THEN the admin console shall require approval by the support lead before posting the adjustment.
Rationale: Second agents approved each other's adjustments; the support lead approves instead (RDR-003).

Text: The loyalty service shall retain points transaction records for 7 years.
